spans.s: पृ॑शन n. clinging to, tenderness.
पृशनायु॑ f. clinging to, attached, tender.
पृश˚नी॑ f. clinging to, attached, tender.
पृ॑श्निमातृ a. having Pṛśni for a mother (cf. prec.).
पृषत्क m. arrow.

पृ॑षदश्व a. having spotted horses or having antelopes
for horses.
पृ॑षद्वन्त् a. spotted, many-coloured.
पृषित n. rain.

पृष्ट॑ a. asked, questioned, r. that which is asked or
inquired after.
पृष्टि॑ f. rib, पृष्टित॑स् on the ribs.
पृष्टी॑ f. rib, पृष्टित॑स् on the ribs.
पृष्ट्या॑ f. side-horse.
पृष्ठग a. being on the back, mounted on (gen. or —˚).
पृष्ठभाग m. hinder part, back.
पृष्ठय॑ज्वन् a. worshipping on hills.
पृष्ठवास्तु n. the upper story or top of a house.
पृष्ठानुग a. going behind, following.
पृष्ठानु˚गामिन् a. going behind, following.
पृष्ठानुपृष्ठिका f. following, persecuting.*
पृ॑ष्व a. consisting of dew or rime.
